# P1-A intra-genre retrieval

Same-genre Last.fm positive links may be incomplete. This is descriptive validation-only analysis; no causal, superiority, significance, or generalization claim is made.

Test-source files and partition IDs are integrity-only and never enter feature inputs, queries, galleries, relevance, metrics, or training.

Ineligible query reasons are counted per fold/system as missing_or_unusable_genre, no_candidates, and no_in_gallery_positive; eligible_small_gallery separately counts eligible queries with fewer than 10 candidates.

`directed_query_relevance_count` counts query-positive directions; `unique_undirected_in_genre_positive_edge_count` counts each in-gallery positive pair once (the directed count is normally twice the undirected count). Both values are recorded in experiment.json and the macro-query row of per_fold_seed_genre_metrics.csv.
